001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jbosslogging;
002
003import java.util.ArrayDeque;
004import java.util.Collections;
005import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
006import java.util.Map;
007
008import org.jboss.logging.Logger;
009import org.jboss.logging.LoggerProvider;
010import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
011
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LoggerAPI;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
015import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
016
017/**
018 * Native {@link LoggerProvider} for JBoss Logging backed directly by
019 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter#global()}, not through SLF4J.
020 * <p>
021 * MDC/NDC storage below is ported from upstream's own
022 * {@code org.jboss.logging.AbstractLoggerProvider}/{@code AbstractMdcLoggerProvider}
023 * (same behavior, including {@code getNdc()}'s space-joined merged form) since both are
024 * package-private and cannot be extended from outside {@code org.jboss.logging}. MDC
025 * values are stringified on put (mirroring {@code Slf4jLoggerProvider}'s own
026 * {@code MDC.put(key, String.valueOf(value))}) so they can be surfaced directly as
027 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues} without a second conversion step.
028 */
029@ServiceProvider(LoggerProvider.class)
030public final class RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider implements LoggerProvider {
031
032        private final ThreadLocal<Map<String, String>> mdcMap = new ThreadLocal<>();
033
034        private final ThreadLocal<ArrayDeque<NdcEntry>> ndcStack = new ThreadLocal<>();
035
036        /*
037         * JBoss Logging creates one provider and org.jboss.logging.MDC goes through it. Null
038         * until then, in which case nothing can have been put in its MDC yet.
039         */
040        private static volatile @Nullable RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider current;
041
042        /**
043         * For {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}.
044         */
045        @SuppressWarnings("StaticAssignmentInConstructor") // see current
046        public RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider() {
047                current = this;
048        }
049
050        /*
051         * Removes both thread locals (MDC and NDC) rather than emptying them, so a pooled
052         * thread keeps nothing.
053         */
054        static void clearCurrentThreadContext() {
055                var provider = current;
056                if (provider != null) {
057                        provider.mdcMap.remove();
058                        provider.ndcStack.remove();
059                }
060        }
061
062        static KeyValues currentMDCKeyValues() {
063                var provider = current;
064                if (provider == null) {
065                        return KeyValues.of();
066                }
067                var mdc = provider.mdcSnapshot();
068                return mdc.isEmpty() ? KeyValues.of() : KeyValues.of(mdc);
069        }
070
071        @Override
072        public Logger getLogger(String name) {
073                var gum = RainbowGum.getOrNull();
074                if (gum != null) {
075                        gum.config().loggerRegistry().registerLoggerName(LoggerAPI.Standard.JBOSS_LOGGING, name);
076                }
077                return new RainbowGumJBossLogger(name, this);
078        }
079
080        /**
081         * The current thread's MDC, already string-valued, ready to become
082         * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues}.
083         * @return possibly empty, never <code>null</code>.
084         */
085        Map<String, String> mdcSnapshot() {
086                var map = mdcMap.get();
087                return map == null || map.isEmpty() ? Collections.emptyMap() : map;
088        }
089
090        @Override
091        public void clearMdc() {
092                var map = mdcMap.get();
093                if (map != null) {
094                        map.clear();
095                }
096        }
097
098        @Override
099        public @Nullable Object getMdc(String key) {
100                var map = mdcMap.get();
101                return map == null ? null : map.get(key);
102        }
103
104        @Override
105        public Map<String, Object> getMdcMap() {
106                var map = mdcMap.get();
107                return map == null ? Collections.emptyMap() : new LinkedHashMap<>(map);
108        }
109
110        @Override
111        public @Nullable Object putMdc(String key, @Nullable Object value) {
112                var map = mdcMap.get();
113                if (map == null) {
114                        map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
115                        mdcMap.set(map);
116                }
117                if (value == null) {
118                        return map.remove(key);
119                }
120                return map.put(key, String.valueOf(value));
121        }
122
123        @Override
124        public void removeMdc(String key) {
125                var map = mdcMap.get();
126                if (map != null) {
127                        map.remove(key);
128                }
129        }
130
131        @Override
132        public void clearNdc() {
133                var stack = ndcStack.get();
134                if (stack != null) {
135                        stack.clear();
136                }
137        }
138
139        @Override
140        public @Nullable String getNdc() {
141                var stack = ndcStack.get();
142                return stack == null || stack.isEmpty() ? null : stack.peek().merged;
143        }
144
145        @Override
146        public int getNdcDepth() {
147                var stack = ndcStack.get();
148                return stack == null ? 0 : stack.size();
149        }
150
151        @Override
152        public String peekNdc() {
153                var stack = ndcStack.get();
154                return stack == null || stack.isEmpty() ? "" : stack.peek().current;
155        }
156
157        @Override
158        public String popNdc() {
159                var stack = ndcStack.get();
160                return stack == null || stack.isEmpty() ? "" : stack.pop().current;
161        }
162
163        @Override
164        public void pushNdc(String message) {
165                var stack = ndcStack.get();
166                if (stack == null) {
167                        stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
168                        ndcStack.set(stack);
169                }
170                stack.push(stack.isEmpty() ? new NdcEntry(message) : new NdcEntry(stack.peek(), message));
171        }
172
173        @Override
174        public void setNdcMaxDepth(int maxDepth) {
175                var stack = ndcStack.get();
176                if (stack != null) {
177                        while (stack.size() > maxDepth) {
178                                stack.pop();
179                        }
180                }
181        }
182
183        private static final class NdcEntry {
184
185                private final String merged;
186
187                private final String current;
188
189                NdcEntry(String current) {
190                        this.merged = current;
191                        this.current = current;
192                }
193
194                NdcEntry(NdcEntry parent, String current) {
195                        this.merged = parent.merged + ' ' + current;
196                        this.current = current;
197                }
198
199        }
200
201}
